overview.about: The Memorial Tournament is a PGA Tour signature event founded and hosted by Jack Nicklaus at his Muirfield Village course in Ohio. Renowned for its immaculate conditioning and demanding layout, it honours a different figure from golf's history each year. Tiger Woods has won it a record five times.
overview.nextEvent: The next Memorial Tournament is played at Muirfield Village Golf Club in Dublin, Ohio. As a signature event it carries a limited elite field, a large purse and a place among the most prestigious non-major titles in golf.
